title: OpenAI's announcement says compute campus. The buildings are still data centers.
friendlyTitle: OpenAI is calling data centers 'compute campuses'
summary: The Verge reports that OpenAI's Grid Protectors announcement, for a site in Effingham County, Georgia, uses 'compute campus' far more often than 'data center.' OpenAI says it will pay the costs it creates and help communities keep power on in extreme weather. OpenAI did not answer The Verge on why the name changed.
friendlySummary: The Verge noticed that OpenAI's new power announcement, for a site in Georgia, mostly says 'compute campus' instead of 'data center.' OpenAI says it will pay the power costs it creates. It did not explain the new name.
whyItMatters: A new label does not change electricity use, water, or who pays. If a project is proposed near you, read the power and cost commitment, not the noun in the press release.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Changing the word does not change the building, the electricity, or the bill. If one is planned near you, read the power promise, not the label.
